setup: The first image-build attempt ran before the dedicated Docker context was available and exited without workload resources. Its output remains in the validation capsule. The same profile startup completed; the subsequent build produced the verified image.
limitations: One shared Mac and one Colima VM with RustFS, no independent failure domains or Amazon S3. Other profiles and host workloads remain uncontrolled and are observed, not modified.

The 30 active cells, 10 offered operations/second, Quorum acknowledgements, 100 ms ticks, thirty-second warmup and 120-second measurement are unchanged. Each Cellar node retains one CPU, 3 GiB and no swap.

Phase timings aggregate independent operations. Exchange counts windows and includes connection setup; runtime admission is not a durability proof. Host/sample windows and owner clocks remain in raw evidence. These observations alone do not establish per-command causality.
No measured instrumentation-overhead or causal cross-revision speedup claim. Earlier traffic failures remain at their original source pins; historical evidence requires its recorded analyzer.

MR-14 remains in progress: sustained S3, equivalent-contract comparison, steady-state/overhead and Q1 capacity gates remain. Q1 still exceeds both the authorized five-node scope and the 4,096 replica bound.
Exact owned containers are stopped, their inspected empty networks removed, and data volumes/raw evidence retained. Only the dedicated profile was controlled, and it is stopped.
findings: The first 150-cell control completes 1,200/1,200 operations with 70.981 ms p99 and passes traffic objectives; the repeat completes 1,165/1,200 with 35 generator rejections and 247.441 ms p99, so repeatable local capacity remains unqualified.

The 500-cell run reconciles all 1,500 replicas but misses the unchanged 200 ms latency objective at 201.343 ms p99, with three generator rejections. Its aggregate sender queue and SQL staging times rise; receiver admission remains shorter. These are phase observations, not a causal diagnosis.

The 1,500-cell attempt fails its original 600-second leader-placement deadline before workload measurement. Node 1 exits with Raft catalog: Runtime(Overloaded), exit code 1 and no OOM. The other four nodes report 900 groups ready. Raw startup diagnostics and shutdown logs remain retained; no capacity result is assigned.

Code inspection identifies early group route publication before all runtime attachments and before the host event consumer starts. A focused regression and startup admission fix are the next priority; the observed physical cause is not yet proven.
